sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the complete file bytes, computed at intake before any adapter reads the file.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, always UTC with a literal Z suffix.

runId.description: ULID. Locally generated, unique per inspection run on this device. Carries no cross-device correlation value and is never derived from file contents or paths.

findingId.description: Stable within one run. Not stable across runs, even for the same input.

detectorId.description: Namespaced detector identifier, e.g. pdf.metadata, image.exif_gps, ocr.visible_text.

pageNumber.description: 1-based page index as presented to the user.

rect.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in the coordinate space named by the enclosing location.

space.description: pdf_user_space has its origin at the bottom-left of the page; image_pixels at the top-left of the image.

confidence.description: Detector-reported confidence. Only meaningful on probabilistic findings; its calibration is reported separately per §17.2.

surface.description: A place a reader can look inside a file. Defined once and referenced everywhere it is used: a capability declaring a surface it can verify, a verification read path naming the surface it examined, and an action result listing the surfaces it checked all have to mean the same seven things. Four inline copies agreed by copy-paste until this existed, which is not a guarantee.

mediaType.description: The media types in scope for the MVP (§4.1). Defined here rather than inside the capability declaration: which formats the product handles is a fact about product scope, and the status rules need it too. Having status read it out of the capability contract pointed the dependency the wrong way.
